sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा विष्णुवचनं ब्रह्मा लोकगुरुः प्रभुः ।लोकान्सान्तानिकान्नाम यास्यन्तीमे समागताः ।। ७.११०.१८ ॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā viṣṇuvacanaṁ brahmā lokaguruḥ prabhuḥ ।lokānsāntānikānnāma yāsyantīme samāgatāḥ ।। 7.110.18 ॥

translations.english: Having heard those words of Vishnu, Lord Brahma, the preceptor of the worlds, declared that all these assembled beings would go to the worlds named Santanika.
